title: se-implementation-scratchpad-silver-lake-bank
content:
Quick scratchpad for Silver Lake Bank private deployment / initial se implementation.

Goal: get SLB on Redwood Private (VPC) for internal document summarization + secure query endpoint. MVP: private inference for doc-search+QA (embedding index + LLM for rerank + generation).

Meeting notes (2026-02-23 sync w/ SLB infra + security):
- SLB wants private control plane with no egress to internet for model infer calls.
- They will host compute in us-east-1 (acct: 123456789012). Need VPC peering & route table + shared S3 access via VPC endpoint.
- Compliance: KMS-managed keys (HSM not required for MVP) and audit logs forwarded to their Splunk instance.
- Expected traffic: 50 req/s peak, avg 20 req/s. Want 99th pct latency < 800ms for 512-token generations.

Open questions / risks:
- Quantization requirement: will SLB accept int8 quantized variant? They asked about accuracy drop - need evals (action: run eval on SLB prompt set).
- Network egress: our private control plane needs read-only metadata access to our org. We must confirm control plane IP ranges and whether whitelist is acceptable. (Action: ask infra for static IPs)
- Data residency: some docs tagged EU only. For now first rollout is us-only; EU plan later.

Customer-specific config notes (rough):
- Target model: redwood-13b-v1 (quantized int8 for cost) with fallback to redwood-13b-fp16 for quality-sensitive flows.
- Serving setup: 4x A10G (dedicated for SLB private pool), autoscale min 2 / max 6.
- KV cache policy: persistent per-connection, TTL 12h for session reuse.
- Batching: 50ms latency target + dynamic batching window up to 8 requests.
- S3 buckets: slb-llm-data (read-only role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/SLB_Redwood_ReadOnly).

Action items (owner / ETA):
- Priya: request control-plane IP ranges from infra + add to SLB network checklist (ETA 2026-02-26).
- Luca: run quant/eval on int8 vs fp16 for SLB prompt set and produce quality delta report (ETA 2026-03-01).
- Samir: prepare IAM role and VPC endpoint policy sample for SLB infra (ETA 2026-02-28).
- Priya: draft runbook for failover to hosted redwood-13b-fp16 in case private pool is degraded (ETA 2026-03-03).

Quick todos / notes to self:
- Confirm Splunk endpoint + log format (jsonl vs syslog) and retention requirements.
- Check if SLB requires HIPAA/PCI scoping for any customer docs (flag in Confluence).
- Add canary rollout plan for initial 5 internal users before org-wide.
- Add prompts/testset to shared drive: google_drive/shared_drives/solutions-engineering/slb-testset.csv

Misc brainstorm (not for customer):
- Consider offering lighter-weight rerank-only endpoint (embedding + small cross-encoder) to reduce peak GPU load.
- If quantization leads to >2% EM drop on SLB eval, propose hybrid: int8 for embeddings+retrieval, fp16 for final generation.

End of scratchpad.
